body:
Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

Broadcom Inc.’s Wall Street syndicate is starting to gather $60 billion of fresh AI chip financing to benefit Anthropic PBC and other companies, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

Banks involved in the massive debt package, including Bank of America Corp., Citigroup Inc. and Morgan Stanley, are poised to send out syndication letters for a $42 billion Class A senior-secured tranche, the people said, asking not to be identified discussing the deal, which has yet to be announced. Broadcom will provide so-called residual value support that effectively backstops that portion of the financing, the people said.
